title: A colloid
caption: In a colloid, particles between about 1 and 1000 nm are dispersed through another substance. They are too small to settle but large enough to scatter light, which is why a beam shows up passing through milk or fog (the Tyndall effect).
alt: A box of water containing a few much larger dispersed particles.
description: A few far larger colloidal particles, spread evenly and not settling.
